rawContent: The #MeToo mural here at our space inside Chuco’s Justice Center is a message & symbol of love for those of us who bear the trauma & burden of being survivors of abuse and assault. This is one effort to uplift the process of transformation & healing. We love you. ❤️✊🏿✊🏾✊🏽 https://t.co/8IB3Mu8MkY
